changes: Implemented active worktree changed-file projection in packages/main/src/core/lattice-parallel-wave.ts, added actual material file overlap detection, failed-probe plan_only degradation, shared material-exclusion handling, relative worktree path resolution, and smoke coverage in packages/main/src/tasks/lattice-parallel-wave-smoke.ts. Updated docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-parallel-wave.md to describe the Non-authority boundary and overlap semantics.
usage: Run lattice parallel_merge_queue --storyIds=["B-xxxx","B-yyyy"] --format=json, or use parallel_plan / parallel_status, to see changedFiles, actualFileOverlaps, blockers, guidance, and whether each story is parallel_dev, plan_only, or blocked.
expectedOutcome: When active stories modify the same material file, Lattice CLI should surface the overlapping file and peer story, demote affected stories to plan_only, keep unrelated stories eligible for parallel_dev, and never claim Authority Server completion from local scheduling evidence.
actualTranscript: After syncing main, npm --prefix packages/main run build passed; node packages/main/dist/tasks/lattice-parallel-wave-smoke.js passed; node packages/main/dist/cli.js parallel_merge_queue --storyIds=["B-8404"] --format=json returned productionDone=false, authorityChanged=false, receiptRefs=[]; lattice validate --story=B-8404 --json passed with 12/12 verification intents covered.
outcomeDiff: Expected and actual match. The live B-8404 queue has no peer overlap so it remains parallel_dev; deterministic smoke fixtures prove overlapping peers degrade to plan_only and failed probes stay visible.
limitations: No Authority Server completion is claimed; this is local Non-authority scheduling guidance only. It detects file-level overlap, not semantic conflicts inside different files.
pitfalls: After merging main, all verification evidence became stale; the fix was to rerun build/smoke/validate and use verification_evidence_refresh_stale before final validation.
